Other repos: no related code. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is not used as evidence
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark mentions Vault and Code Split (cannot verify from repo). There is no flow deck. The hirer's 3rd letter = stage RR3 (see OCMS12.31). The check for the latest mobile/email from DataHive (Singpass/CorpPass) after the 3rd letter is in the eNotification job, but it is locked by cron.enareminder.datahive=false (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48; dev and uat are false too), so only the data already on the notice is used. The eNotification job itself is also cron.notification.enabled=false in PROD (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236; NotificationJobsScheduler.java:49-52) and ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 says 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'. The only DataHive contact lookup active in PROD is at LTA download (when the notice is created). The word 'DOS' is not in the code: DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Fits are kept equal to OCMS12.18 (owner) and OCMS9.6.
recommendation: Claim partially. The DataHive contact-check code for reminders exists, but the flags cron.enareminder.datahive and cron.notification.enabled are off in PROD. Switch both on in UAT and show one RR3 hirer whose contact is refreshed before the SMS/email goes out

steps.step: After the 3rd letter is sent, the hirer's notice at stage RR3 becomes a candidate for the electronic reminder
steps.detail: After the RR3 letter is processed for Toppan, the notice's last_processing_stage becomes RR3 (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1514-1524). The eNotification job calls queryRecordsForReminder() (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:162), which picks notices with last_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3) and offender_indicator Y whose due date (last_processing_date + parameter POS + PDD) falls inside the ENOTEDAYS window (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1109-1114, 1135-1160), then sets that stage as nextProcessingStage (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:170-182). The query does not tell owner and hirer apart, so a hirer at RR3 is included. The 'letter first, then an electronic reminder that refers to the letter' order matches the story. The ENOTEDAYS/POS/PDD values are in the DB (cannot verify from repo). Note: stage RR3 can advance although the file did not reach Toppan (see OCMS12.31). Same fit as OCMS12.18.

steps.step: OCMS checks the latest mobile number of an individual hirer from DOS (Singpass via DataHive)
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and refreshContactInfo for all records (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:183-187). refreshContactInfo only queries DataHive when cron.enareminder.datahive=true (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:92-93, 2468); the value is false in PROD (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48; dev and uat are false too), so only the phoneNo already on the record is used (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2468-2477). The live path exists: refreshIndividualContactInfo fetches CONTACT via getContactInfoFromSingpass and accepts it when it has at least 8 characters (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2706-2735). The only DataHive lookup active in PROD is at LTA download (LtaSnowflakeProcessor.java:78-83), i.e. when the notice is created, not after the 3rd letter. The job also runs the refresh for all records before the exclusion gate (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:183-195). The word 'DOS' does not appear in the code: DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. The DataHive view contents and connection cannot verify from repo. Same fit as OCMS12.18 and OCMS9.6.

steps.step: OCMS checks the latest email of a company hirer from DOS (CorpPass via DataHive)
steps.detail: refreshCompanyContactInfo fetches CP_ACCOUNT_EMAIL from the CorpPass view by UEN and only accepts accounts with ACCOUNT_TYPE A01 and status ACTIVE (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2496-2560). But like the individual step, the call is locked by cron.enareminder.datahive=false (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2468-2481; cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so the email used is the one already on the record. The CorpPass lookup at LTA download is active (DataHiveContactServiceImpl.java:146-153) but happens when the notice is created. Same fit as OCMS12.18 and OCMS9.6.

steps.step: The latest mobile number / email is saved to the hirer's data on the notice
steps.detail: When the DataHive path is active, updateOcmsContactInfo patches offenderTelNo and emailAddr in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver per noticeNo + idNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2764, 2800-2822) and updateOcmsCompanyContactInfo patches the company emailAddr (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2676-2698). Because the datahive flag is false (steps 2-3), this update does not run in PROD for the eNotification path. Same fit as OCMS12.18.

steps.step: The electronic reminder is only prepared when a valid contact exists (SMS for individual hirers, email for company hirers)
steps.detail: validateContactInfo rejects records with contactError, a company without email, or an individual without a phone number (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2292). In the job, invalid non-ENA records are skipped (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266) and companies do not enter the SMS batch (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:269-277). The channel is decided by idType: B -> EMAIL, otherwise SMS (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:443-453). So the reminder is only prepared when a contact exists, matching the aim 'so that an electronic reminder can be sent'. Same fit as OCMS12.18.
